scores.tell: Muted dusty periwinkle/pink pastel palette; low chroma overall, hero blue-grey blends with hazy background. Real cards are louder with clear hue contrast.
Natural saturated blue sea, orange wood, sand and red/white ring read like real cards; slightly many hue families, otherwise close.
Orange/yellow hero on purple stripes, loud and flat like real cards (towel/whistle); none significant.
Green grass is a bit dull and muted, with the ball's black and white; background a little drab compared with real cards' vivid green.
Navy, cyan and cream on bright yellow with orange pattern; clear hue roles, as in real cards. None.
Blue, orange and yellow-gold on lilac; lilac background is pale and desaturated next to the hero's loud colors, slightly more pastel than real cards.
Golden rope on saturated purple, with a small red accent; palette matches real cards. None.
Orange backdrop with a brown boot, a close match to the real orange-themed cards; the boot is slightly low in chroma.
Dark indigo hat on orange; hero is nearly neutral-dark and purple/orange are complementary, so it is loud but the shadows are very dark and heavy. Real cards keep brighter hero colors.
Bright greens and sky blue with a lilac-grey club head; lightly washed sky, but it is mostly in line with real cards.
